clauses.clause_label: Allowed Use — inspection, build, modification, and server use
clauses.scope_note: Permission to view, study, and build the Plugin Portal source code, fork and modify it, and use the software—including modified versions—on Minecraft servers the licensee owns or operates. Does not grant rights to hosted services or APIs.
clauses.condition_explanation: Server use is limited to Minecraft servers owned or operated by the licensee.

clauses.clause_label: Allowed Use — sharing contributions and distributing non-commercial forks
clauses.scope_note: Covers sharing patches, pull requests, bug reports, and other contributions with the Plugin Portal project, and distributing non-commercial forks. The stated fork conditions apply to distribution of forks; the text does not make them conditions on sharing contributions with the project.
clauses.condition_explanation: A fork may be distributed only if it is non-commercial, clearly identified as a fork, preserves the license, and does not provide premium functionality without valid Plugin Portal entitlement.

clauses.clause_label: Restrictions — sale, sublicensing, commercial distribution, and competing services
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits selling, reselling, sublicensing, renting, leasing, or commercially distributing the software or a modified version. Also prohibits publishing, distributing, or operating a competing public plugin, marketplace service, updater service, or entitlement service derived from the software. The commercial-distribution restriction does not state a general prohibition on every commercial use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The competing-service restriction applies to a service or public plugin that is competing and derived from the software.

clauses.clause_label: Restrictions — security and premium entitlement controls
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits removing, disabling, bypassing, weakening, or altering license-key, premium-entitlement, API-authentication, or feature-gating functionality. Also prohibits providing users access to Plugin Portal premium features, including features formerly shipped in Plugin Portal Premium, without valid Plugin Portal license or entitlement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The premium-feature access prohibition applies when users are provided access without valid Plugin Portal license or entitlement.

clauses.clause_label: Restrictions — notices, project identity, and brand assets
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits removing, obscuring, or altering copyright, attribution, license, or security notices; misrepresenting a fork or modified version as the official project; and using Plugin Portal names, logos, icons, marketplace listings, or other brand assets except as allowed by TRADEMARKS.md. That referenced file’s terms are not supplied here.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use of brand assets is excepted only to the extent allowed by TRADEMARKS.md; its conditions cannot be determined from this text.

clauses.clause_label: Hosted Services and APIs — scope exclusion and access
clauses.scope_note: The hosted Plugin Portal API, dashboard, release storage, entitlement checks, and related infrastructure are expressly not licensed by this repository. Their access may be limited, changed, or revoked independently. This is not a grant or a prohibition on use of those services.
clauses.condition_explanation: No permission to use the hosted services is supplied by this repository license; access terms are outside the supplied text.

clauses.clause_label: Hosted Services and APIs — replacement service restriction
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits using the software to create or distribute a replacement service when its primary intended purpose is to bypass the specified licensing, API access controls, or marketplace/update enforcement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the replacement service is primarily intended to bypass Plugin Portal premium licensing, API access controls, or marketplace/update enforcement.

clauses.clause_label: Contributions — license grant and contributor representation
clauses.scope_note: By submitting a contribution to the repository, the contributor grants Flyte a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, copy, modify, distribute, sublicense, and commercialize that contribution as part of Plugin Portal, and represents that they have the right to submit it. The grant is to Flyte, not a grant to downstream recipients.
clauses.condition_explanation: The grant and representation apply upon submission of a contribution to the repository.

coverage_notes: Scope is the Plugin Portal source code in this repository, including the identified historical names and free, premium, single-jar, and merged release lines; this text is not a universal license for hosted services or third-party dependencies.
TRADEMARKS.md is incorporated for permitted brand-asset use but is not supplied, so its terms cannot be extracted.

The text says separate written permission may be sought for uses outside the license, including commercial distribution, resale, or a derived public service; it does not supply the terms of any such permission.
Warranty and liability disclaimers are omitted as unrelated to the requested activity/subject/constraint clauses.
